coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: pdfplumber: drawn rules (thin filled rects, cell-border pieces merged per line), underscore characters, the tick-box pictures and bold "o" glyphs (ink measured on a 400 dpi render); every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: general partner office (General Partner Use Only box, page 5)
selling dealer and registered representative (Section 7, page 8)
signing.kind: Subscription agreement of a limited partnership (HTML form printed landscape). The investor initials eight statements and signs Section 6 with a co-investor; an authorised custodian, trustee, officer or partner signs for an entity; the registered representative completes and signs Section 7; the general partner accepts on page 8. A special payment instruction form (pages 14-15) and a letter of direction for LEAF I/II investors (pages 16-17) carry their own signatures.
signing.individual_and_entity: separated in the signature blocks only: left column investor and co-investor, right column "Authorized Signature (Custodian/Trustee/Officer/Partner)"

sure_per_page.15: sure of every place; whose the two foot-of-column Date lines are is a judgement
